mapper.select: select child.MODULEID,child.MODULENAME,f.FILEID,child.PARENTMODULEID from Xw_Module child inner join Xw_Module parent on child.PARENTMODULEID = parent.MODULEID inner join CF_FILE f on child.MODULEID = f.FILEREFID where parent.ISSUBJECT = 1 order by parent.MODULENAME,child.MODULEORDER,child.MODULEID
